about.title: About State Roofing Company
text: Houston is one of the fastest-growing metropolitan areas in the United States, with a housing market that continues to expand year after year. That growth, combined with the region’s demanding subtropical climate, means property owners need roofing professionals who truly understand what it takes to protect a building in Southeast Texas.

Whether you own a single-family home in the Heights, a commercial building near the Energy Corridor, or a multi-family complex in Katy, our scope of services covers every phase of a roofing project. From roof repair to complete roof installation, we tailor our approach to the specific needs of each structure and each owner. Our process begins with a thorough inspection, followed by a detailed written work order that outlines both material and labor specifications so you know exactly what to expect.

Not all roofing contractors carry the same credentials. State Roofing Company is a GAF Master Elite Contractor, a distinction held by only a small percentage of roofing professionals nationwide. GAF is an American-owned manufacturer, and earning Master Elite status requires demonstrated commitment to ongoing training, proper licensing, and a proven reputation in the community. We have also earned the GAF President’s Club Residential Award, which recognizes the top-performing contractors within the Master Elite program for excellence in installation quality and customer satisfaction.
